hooks.name: Test on Save — Backend

action.prompt:
A backend Python file was just saved. Find its matching test file
   (e.g. backend/app/foo.py -> backend/tests/test_foo.py). If a matching
   test file exists, run it with pytest and report pass/fail results,
   including the failure traceback for any failing test, in chat. If no
   matching test file exists, do nothing and don't mention it.

hooks.description: Run the matching pytest file when a backend Python file is saved.
